definitions.explanation: The direction from which the wind is blowing. A compound of {風|ふう/かぜ} (wind) and {向|こう} (direction). Also used figuratively to mean the direction of public opinion or the trend of a situation.

examples.japanese: {風向|ふうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
{風向|ふうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦テント→テント：03859_tento⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}ろう→張る：12583_haru⟧。
examples.english: Let's check the wind direction before pitching the tent.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世論|せろん}→世論：05315_seron⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{風向|ふうこう}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わり→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧、⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧ことになった。
examples.english: The direction of public opinion shifted, and the government decided to review its policy.

notes:
A compound of {風|ふう} (wind) and {向|こう} (direction). The word {風向|ふうこう}き (with き) is the more common everyday form. {風向|ふうこう} alone is used in meteorological and technical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {風向|ふうこう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧: the wind direction changes
- {風向|ふうこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to check the wind direction
- {風向|ふうこう}⟦{計|けい}→計：02691_kei⟧: wind vane; anemoscope
- {風向|ふうこう}き: wind direction (colloquial form with き suffix)

USAGE:
In its figurative sense, {風向|ふうこう}き refers to the prevailing mood or trend of a situation, similar to the English expression "the way the wind blows."

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{風速|ふうそく}→風速：24554_fuusoku⟧: wind speed — often mentioned alongside wind direction in weather reports
- ⟦{風力|ふうりょく}→風力：06432_fuuryoku⟧: wind force; wind power — the strength of the wind
- ⟦{方角|ほうがく}→方角：08447_hougaku⟧: direction; compass point — general directional orientation
